dialogue.line: Guess you're not just some nobody after all, I've underestimated you for a bit.
Beep bap bop bip bep skboop
Yeah, it is a wonderful tune.
We used to sing it every monday.
She would tell me that if anything happens between us, we would always stay together.
She always had a soft heart.
Yeah. I miss her a lot.
I swore to myself that I wouldn't let anything in this world hurt her.
I haven't been the best at patience, but I never showed it to her.
I never wanted her heart to feel sorrow because of how I act.
You shouldn't argue with your bride, even if you're in the right.
If we sing a loud tune, we may be able to signal others!
What? Don't be stupid. This isn't an earthquake.
